Bio

I'm Chloe Kim — an AI Interaction Designer who spent five years at Samsung shaping how millions of people experience intelligent technology every day.

At Samsung, I specialized in Home Robots and Conversational AI — designing the interaction language for embodied AI systems and voice-first experiences that live in people's homes and daily lives.

My practice sits at the edge of human behavior, emerging technology, and craft — asking not just what AI can do, but what it should feel like to live with.
